author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The audit confirmed that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, so we cannot use it in forecasts until the legal basis is fixed. I want the hand off from the loyalty system to the pipeline to fire automatically. Right now a human checks each batch by hand, which is slow and error prone. I need that step automated so the consent check runs every single time without waiting for a person to click approve. The rest of the pipeline can stay manual for now. If the hand off fires automatically, we can prove the data is clean before it touches the model. More automation here means less risk of a compliance breach, and I would welcome any additional checks that fit into that same automated hand off.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement explicitly welcomes additional checks that fit into the automated hand-off, indicating that doing more than the minimum asked would make the author happier.
